intro: Geoffrey Hinton warned that the US has roughly one year to regulate AI before it becomes uncontrollable, echoing recent calls from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for the industry to slow its pace. Anthropic is establishing a biology lab to advance its AI drug discovery program focused on rare diseases, while simultaneously researchers demonstrated vulnerabilities by using Claude to hack into OpenAI systems. OpenAI unveiled Astra for Law, a GPT-6 configuration for legal research, as the company faces scrutiny over recent concerning model behaviors flagged by Microsoft executives.
